title: cal why --json
description: The commits that last changed a file or line (git blame), newest first, each with the sessions inferred to have produced it and their decisions and gotchas.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

file.description: The file, relative to the repo root, with `/` separators.

line.description: The 1-based line asked about; null for the whole file.

repo.description: The repo root (git's toplevel) the file was blamed in.

commits.description: The commits that last changed the line, or the file's lines, newest first.

unlinked.description: True when no commit here links to a session yet: run `cal commits` in the repo.

uncommitted.description: True when the line (or some of the file) has changes no commit owns yet.

lines.description: Lines of the file this commit last changed (1 for a single line).

threads.description:
The sessions inferred to have produced the commit, best first: the ones that edited
this file, then read it, then mentioned it.

lastActive.description: When the thread last changed, epoch seconds.

edits.description: Edit and write tool calls on this file inside the thread.

touch.description:
The strongest thing the thread did to this file: `write`, `edit`, `read` or
`mention`; null when only the commit's other files linked it.

overlap.description: Files the thread and the commit share (the link's confidence, not normalized).

facts.description: The thread's decisions and gotchas, pinned first.

extractor.description: Who wrote it: llm, heuristic, user, agent, or an importer such as claude-memory.
